action: No action needed. If you booked or changed a stay on November 17, check your confirmation email, or call the hotel directly to verify the reservation.
exec: Short sign-in disruption at a major hotel group; the company says it is resolved and not cyber-related.
plain: Marriott customers had trouble signing in to the website and app on the morning of November 17. Marriott says the technical problem is fixed and it found no sign of a cyberattack.
summary: Downdetector reports from about 9:46 a.m. ET on November 17 described trouble logging in to Marriott's app and website. Marriott later said it had resolved a technical disruption that temporarily prevented sign-in to Marriott.com and the Bonvoy app, and that its review found no indication it was cybersecurity-related. No further cause was given.
title: Marriott customers report login and reservation problems

review.note: Fox says Marriott stated the sign-in disruption was resolved and found no cyber indication; sources give no 'hundreds' count or 9:17 time (Yahoo: 9:46 a.m.). Summary, plain and exec rewritten.
